SELECT DATE(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = 'd18bd8f2-dfcd-11eb-ba80-0242ac130004') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime ASC LIMIT 1
